title: QUIC RFC 9000 S17P1 Packet Number Encoding Completion Verification
verification_method: Focused S17P1 requirement-home tests over protected Initial, Handshake, and Application Data packet-number encoding and open paths, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the focused generated S17P1 packet-number encoding proof tail for full-width pre-ack encoding, post-ack range sufficiency, and out-of-order recovery with four-byte packet numbers.
expected_result: The focused tests show that Initial and Handshake packet builders use four-byte packet numbers before any acknowledgment, the Initial builder reaches the maximum four-byte boundary without truncation, the Application Data builder uses a four-byte packet number at the largest post-ack safe range, late packets missing a packet-number byte fail to open, and out-of-order packets at the four-byte boundary can still be opened and recovered.
procedure: Run the focused S17P1 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The protected packet construction and open seams remain under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.
The packet-protection material test support can create deterministic Initial, Handshake, and OneRtt protection material.
The packet-number field remains constrained to RFC 9000's one-to-four-byte packet header encoding space.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim adaptive packet-number length selection, full packet-number reconstruction for arbitrary reordered receive windows, hosted interop readiness, or closure of deferred fuzz obligations.

status_summary: Local verification on 2026-05-06 passed: focused S17P1 requirement-home filter 19/19; Release build 0 warnings/errors; regenerated QUIC coverage triage 1,323/1,771 trace-clean; SpecTrace core validation 496 artifacts; full Release no-build suite 4,589/4,589; git diff --check exited 0 with only CRLF normalization warnings for generated/spec files.
